decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: Central slot 1, West slot 2, North slot 3, East slot 4, Int'l slot 5
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: North moved 0.12 line heights, East moved 0.12 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “$150K monthly donations”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$150K monthly donations”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
the title wraps onto two lines
comment 1 (“No region strayed more than 10% from it…”) in empty space beside the plot, no arrow (a remark on the whole chart) (G8.7)
the maker's comments in New Computer Modern italic, in the reserved blue, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (G6.3, D-19)
the four questions answered: what matters: the title; why care: comment 1 (not answered: what explains it, what to do, which need be answered only where known) (G8.3)
